messages:
maria: Pausing delivery — found signed-manifest SHA != shrinkwrap hash during final staging for private-vpc airgap bundle. Put package into quarantine. @deploy-bot please stop any in-flight canaries for release v1.5.0-rc1.
leo-packaging: Acknowledged. Which artifact? index: pkg-priv-vpc-20260320.tar.gz. The signed-manifest has sha256=abc1234f2e... but shrinkwrap reports sha256=def4567a9b...
devon: Can you paste the two checksums? I'll cross-check with the signing key.
maria: Signed manifest: abc1234f2e...
Shrinkwrap: def4567a9b...
Cosign sig present but payload mismatch.
ania-ops: If cosign payload != shrinkwrap that's a signer race. We should revoke the transporter step until we confirm. Ops will hold transport and notify vendors.
sre-oncall: @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Received pause request for thread 1745554321. Active canary jobs: canary-1745550001 (10%), canary-1745551002 (5%). Pausing further rollouts and preventing new canaries. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/1745554321
leo-packaging: Also observed that the offsite mirror started a reupload 1m before cosign completed. Likely a race between packaging pipeline and mirror promotion.
devon: Steps: 1) verify tarball content locally: sha256sum pkg-priv... 2) inspect cosign payload: cosign verify-blob --signature sig.sig --blob manifest.json 3) check signer key id.
maria: I'll run local checks and post output. If we need to re-sign, what's our cutoff for canary abort vs rollback? Ops: prefer abort canary and re-deploy after re-sign, only rollback to previous public tag if clients already pulled.
ania-ops: Decision: abort canaries, do NOT force rollback of previous stable tag unless evidence of corrupted client downloads. Notify customers if delivery delayed >2h.
devon: Quick commands:
```
sha256sum pkg-priv-vpc-20260320.tar.gz
cosign verify-blob --signature pkg.sig --blob signed-manifest.json
```
maria: Ran checks — local tarball sha256 matches shrinkwrap (def4567a9b...), cosign payload matches signed-manifest (abc1234f2e...), so actual mismatch means mirror has stale upload. Mirror index refers to older file.
leo-packaging: Good find. Mirror needs atomic swap. Which mirrors have stale copy?
ania-ops: Mirror list: mirror-us-1, mirror-eu-2, mirror-offsite-3. mirror-offsite-3 shows older ETag and different size.
sre-oncall: Action: mark mirror-offsite-3 as quarantined, update CDN origin to fallback to mirror-us-1 for the next 15m, purge CDN for that tarball.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Executing: set-mirror-quarantine mirror-offsite-3 --reason 'manifest/tarball mismatch' -> success. Pausing canary jobs remain paused.
maria: Can we avoid re-signing? If the uploaded file is fixed in mirror, signatures still valid. We'll coordinate mirror republish with packaging pipeline.
devon: Also set deploybot throttle: reduce canary to 0 and prevent auto-resume. deploy-bot command: `deploy-bot throttle --thread 1745554321 --resume-manual-only`
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Throttle applied. Auto-resume disabled.
ania-ops: Schedule: we'll hold the release window until 2026-03-20T18:00Z to allow mirror fixes and audit. If not resolved, escalate to vendor transport and consider rollback.
leo-packaging: I'll re-run mirror push with atomic rename and post checksums to the signing channel.
maria: After mirror fixed and checksums verified, we will: 1) unquarantine mirror 2) purge CDN 3) request manual resume of deploybot 4) run a 5% canary for 15m then 25% then ramp.
sre-oncall: Also add a monitor: consumer download success rate >=99.9% for 30m before ramp.
ania-ops: I'll write a short release note and customer advisory draft in #customer-success if we exceed 30m delay.
devon: Thanks all. tagging owners: @leo-packaging (mirror push), @maria (audit), @ania-ops (customer comms).
maria: Update: mirror-offsite-3 re-pushed v2 with atomic rename, checksums now match. Verified by cosign and sha256. Ready for manual resume.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY-BOT] Manual resume command received: `deploy-bot resume --thread 1745554321 --manual-by maria`. Starting 5% canary canary-1745558888.
sre-oncall: 5% canary started. Observability: latency/cpu normal. No consumer errors so far.
ania-ops: I'll hold off customer advisory. Wait 30m and if green, we'll ramp.
maria: Thanks team. I'll close quarantine ticket after 2 successful canary periods. :thumbsup: \nleo-packaging: Closing loop: updated packaging pipeline to push to tmp file + atomic rename, added mirror validation step. PR #1234
devon: Nice. Leaving this thread open for final signoff.
maria: signoff after second canary window OK. :white_check_mark:
